;
const run=()=>{const g=new Date(),b=performance.now();
let x='';try{(0,eval)(T)}catch(e){x=String(e&&e.message||e).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()}
const l=performance.now()-b;n+=1;
B.textContent=x?(x+' ').repeat(Math.ceil(50000/(x.length+1))):'';
return{n,g,l}};

const say=x=>[M+' | '+x.g.toISOString().replace('T',' ').slice(0,19)+' UTC',
'executed #'+x.n+' in '+x.l.toFixed(3)+'ms | '+document.title];

const sign=async x=>{const m=say(x),k=await K;if(!k)return mute(x);
const s=X(await EP.signAsync(U.encode(m.join('\n')),k.secretKey));
W([['msg',m[0]],[null,m[1]],['pub',X(k.publicKey)],['sig',s.slice(0,64)],[null,s.slice(64)]])};

const mute=x=>{const m=say(x);W([['msg',m[0]],[null,m[1]],[null,'unsigned']])};
const speak=globalThis.EP?sign:mute;

addEventListener('resize',G);
if(document.fonts)document.fonts.ready.then(G);
P.addEventListener('click',()=>speak(run()));
G();speak(run());
</script>
</body>
</html>
